content.short: TON Access is a decentralized RPC service providing reliable and censorship-resistant access to the TON blockchain.
content.description: TON Access is a decentralized, multi-node RPC (Remote Procedure Call) service developed by the Orbs team for the TON blockchain. It provides developers and users with a reliable, high-performance gateway to interact with the network without relying on a single, centralized entry point. By distributing requests across a network of nodes, TON Access ensures high availability, reduced latency, and greater censorship resistance for wallets and dApps, serving as a critical piece of infrastructure for the decentralized future of the TON network.
